# M1 processed outputs

Generated by `python -m src.preprocessing` (Member 1).

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `transactions_cleaned.parquet` | Cleaned line items (no missing Customer ID, no cancellations, valid qty/price, deduplicated) |
| `customer_churn_labels.parquet` | Customer-level churn labels + observation-period summary fields |
| `customer_churn_labels.csv` | Same as parquet (CSV) |
| `m1_validation_report.json` | Cleaning statistics and label validation results |

**Do not edit these files by hand.** Re-run the pipeline to regenerate.
